title: Parametric Calculator Spec (engine #6)
description: Declarative spec for the parametric calculator engine (engine #6, ledger §E / F5b). Declares typed `inputs` (units, ranges, defaults), a referenced deterministic `compute_ref` (a NAMED, pure, unit-checked computation — PPF/DORI, PoE power budget by 802.3af/at/bt, voltage-drop 'will it hold', storage-retention), and `thresholds` (pass/warn/fail bands) each §5.4-tagged with an optional safety_flag. NO LLM, NO network in the compute path (same inputs -> same output). A `meter` spec drives the colorblind-safe visual budget meter (shape + numeric value + color, never color alone). engine_kind is pinned to 'calculator' (academy.sim_kind).

$schema.description: Optional editor/CI hint pointing at this schema's $id.

$computeContract.description: Optional non-normative author+engineering note documenting the referenced formula registry entry (constants, formula, worked example). Ignored by the runtime; lives here so the spec is self-documenting.

envelope.description: Shared sim envelope. engine_kind MUST be 'calculator'.

inputs.description: The parametric inputs the learner sets. Keyed by input id; values are unit-checked and range-bounded.

compute_ref.title: referenced formula id
compute_ref.description: The id of a registered deterministic computation in the calculator engine's formula registry. The spec NEVER carries executable math — it references a vetted, unit-tested function so the compute path stays pure and auditable. The registry id pins the exact wattage/threshold constants used.

result_unit.description: Unit of the computed primary result (e.g. 'W' for poe_power_budget headroom, 'V' for voltage at the lock, 'PPF' for ppf_dori, 'days' for storage_retention).

thresholds.description: Pass/warn/fail bands evaluated against the computed result. Each is §5.4-tagged; a safety_flag band failing routes through the veto hook.

meter.description: The visual budget meter spec ('a budget meter you can blow' — F5b). Colorblind-safe: the renderer shows the numeric value + a shape marker per band, color advisory only.

input.title: typed input
input.description: One calculator input. type + unit + min/max bound the value; the engine unit-checks before compute.

options.description: For type=enum (e.g. a PoE standard pick: 802.3af/at/bt-type3/bt-type4).

allOf.$comment: number/integer inputs must declare a unit (deterministic + unit-checked).

threshold.title: threshold band
threshold.description: A pass/warn/fail band over the computed result. `op` + `value` define the boundary; `band` is the verdict the band yields.

op.description: Comparison of the computed result against `value`.

safety_flag.description: True if breaching this band is a SAFETY-CRITICAL failure (e.g. voltage at a mag lock below hold → the lock chatters/drops; an under-budget PoE switch sheds the front-door camera). Routes through the veto hook + applies the >=90% safety bar (ledger §C).

feedback_i18n.description: Band feedback — names the real-world consequence + the fix (e.g. 'At 10.8 V the 1200s mag lock will chatter and may not hold; increase gauge or shorten the run').

state.description: Colorblind-safe state token to render for this band (pass→check, warn→triangle, fail→cross).

show_numeric_value.description: MUST be true for colorblind-safety: the meter always shows the numeric value, not just a colored fill.

band_markers.description: Shape markers drawn at band boundaries so the band is readable without color.
